info.name: Pinterest - Hacker Green | Dark
info.description:
A terminal-inspired Pinterest theme 

Frosted emerald navigation, dark green cards, bright save controls, readable menus and dialogs, matching fields, focus rings and scrollbars. Terminal font stack: Cascadia Mono, Cascadia Code, JetBrains Mono, Consolas, Lucida Console, Courier New, monospace. No font download is required.

Covers pinterest.com and www.pinterest.com, including feeds, search, pin details, boards, profiles, settings, comments and messaging where matching Pinterest components are present. The domain rule also covers Pinterest subdomains.
